sections.content: You know the present perfect subjunctive from this unit: *haya* + participle. It follows feelings (*me alegro de que hayas venido*), doubt and denial (*dudo que*, *no creo que*) and time words for an action that will be finished first (*cuando*, *en cuanto*).

sections.title: Quick Reference Table
rows: haya, hayas, haya, hayamos, hayáis, hayan + participio
Me alegro de que hayas venido
No creo que hayan dicho la verdad
Te llamo en cuanto haya terminado

items.spanish: Me alegro de que hayamos llegado a tiempo.
items.english: I am glad we arrived on time.

items.spanish: No creo que nadie haya visto las llaves.
items.english: I don't think anyone has seen the keys.

sections.content: Remember: participles never inflect for gender/number in compound tenses (always haya venido, hayan venido).
